hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.sh) command -v shfmt >/dev/null 2>&1 && shfmt -i 4 -w "$f" ;; *.zsh) command -v shfmt >/dev/null 2>&1 && shfmt -i 4 -w -ln zsh "$f" ;; *.py) uv run ruff format "$f" ;; *.json) command -v biome >/dev/null 2>&1 && biome check --write "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
